desc:
羅天大醮之後，王也被武當除名回到了家中，卻因為身懷“八奇技-風后奇門”遭人覬覦，家人遭人監視。王也萬般無奈，在好友諸葛青的建議下向“哪都通”公司的求助，張楚嵐攜馮寶寶前來破案。張楚嵐如何一展身手幫王也抓出幕後黑手？諸葛青和王也等人又將有怎樣精彩的表現？覬覦“八奇技”的人究竟是誰？
Synopsis:
After Raten Taishou, Wang Ye had no choice but went home. Because of Wang's "Fuukou Qimen", peace never comes to him. Wang has to ask 'Na Dou Tong' for help due to Zhuge Qin's suggestion. Feng Lan and Feng Baobao are coming to help him. How does Zhang Chulan find out the biggest boss? What would happen to Zhuge Qin and Wang Ye then? Who is the person wants Wang's "FuuKou Qimen"?
